name: security-watch
description: Polls a security advisory / dependency feed on an interval. judge-triage filters relevance (is this advisory actionable for us?), judge-severity scores it, and judge-risk gates the response: a reversible, well-evidenced patch can be drafted and PR'd automatically; anything riskier waits for human review. Point `source` at your CVE/Dependabot/advisory feed.

phases.name: relevance
phases.description: Does this advisory actually apply to us, or is it noise/duplicate/needs-info?

phases.name: severity
phases.description: How urgent is the exposure (impact × blast-radius × reversibility × urgency)?

phases.name: plan-patch
phases.description: Scope the remediation (dependency bump / config change / mitigation).

phases.name: autonomy-gate
phases.description: Reversible + well-evidenced → auto-PR; otherwise human review; unsafe → block.

phases.name: open-pr
phases.description: Open a PR for the patch.

review.name: await-review
review.description: Hold the patch for a human to review before opening a PR.

block.name: escalate-security
block.description: High-risk change — escalate to a human owner.

code.source: return 'Advisory not applicable to our stack. Ignored.'

needs-info.name: research
needs-info.description: Unclear applicability — gather more detail before deciding.
